Vaishnavi Kulkarni
Financial Analyst | Hyderabad | vaishnavi.kulkarni502@example.com | +91 9383245470

Analytical finance professional with hands-on experience building models, forecasting, and delivering actionable insights to support business decisions. Comfortable working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams to translate data into financial plans and reporting. Technically proficient with Excel and familiar with accounting frameworks and software development practices.

Experience

- Prepared IFRS-compliant journal schedules and variance analyses for month-end close, reducing reconciliation time by 20% through standardized Excel templates.
- Automated recurring reporting tasks using advanced Excel functions and templates, cutting report preparation time from 5 to 2 days while ensuring traceability for audits.

Dream11 — Dec 2021 - Oct 2024
React Native Developer (Remote)
- Developed and maintained cross-platform features in the mobile app using React Native and TypeScript, contributing to a 15% increase in weekly active users for feature launches.
- Implemented modular components and improved build reliability, reducing crash rates by 18% and accelerating release cycles.
- Collaborated with backend engineers and QA to integrate new APIs and streamline data flows, improving end-to-end delivery times by 25% and facilitating smoother analytics for revenue features.
- Used Git and Linux-based tooling for CI workflows and deployments, standardizing branching and release practices across the mobile team.

Projects
- In-app Purchase Forecast Model: Created an Excel-based model to forecast in-app purchase revenue by cohort and seasonality using Financial Modeling techniques; provided weekly FP&A updates to product leads.
